standards.title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V
standards.description: Specifies materials, conductor purity, PVC insulation sheath thickness, and flammability parameters for building and industrial power cables.

clauses.title: Conductor Construction & Electrical Resistance at 20°C
clauses.description: High-conductivity annealed electrolytic grade copper conductor class 2 electrical resistance.
clauses.testMethod: Kelvin Double Bridge measurement in thermostatic water bath at 20°C +/- 0.5°C
clauses.acceptableLimit: Maximum 12.10 Ohm/km for 1.5 sq mm

clauses.title: PVC Insulation Thickness & Dimensional Uniformity
clauses.description: Radial thickness of Type A PVC insulation compound protecting the live core.
clauses.testMethod: Optical profile projector inspection across 6 circumferential cross-sections
clauses.acceptableLimit: Nominal 0.70 mm; Minimum individual point >= 0.53 mm

clauses.title: High Voltage Spark & Dielectric Withstand Test
clauses.description: Dielectric insulation breakdown prevention under high potential AC spark.
clauses.testMethod: Continuous 6.0 kV AC bead-chain spark test during high-speed extrusion run
clauses.acceptableLimit: Zero puncture, sparkover, or dielectric breakdown

clauses.title: Flammability Retardance & Oxygen Index (IS 10810 Pt 58)
clauses.description: Minimum oxygen percentage required to sustain burning of outer PVC sheath.
clauses.testMethod: Controlled chimney burner oxygen index chamber test
clauses.acceptableLimit: Oxygen Index >= 29.0%

standards.title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets for Household and Similar Purposes of Rated Voltage up to 250V and Rated Current up to 16A
standards.description: Statutory safety requirements for domestic plugs and socket-outlets, mandatory safety shutters, thermal rise, and glow-wire fire resistance.

clauses.title: Automatic Safety Shutter Mechanism
clauses.description: Live socket contacts must be protected by integral automatic shutters preventing single-pin insertion.
clauses.testMethod: Single probe insertion gauge test (1.0 mm steel wire at 20 N force)
clauses.acceptableLimit: No contact with live metal

clauses.title: Dimensions and Interchangeability
clauses.description: Standard gauge dimensions for 2-pin and 3-pin plugs to prevent improper mating with non-standard sockets.
clauses.testMethod: Go / No-Go Calibrated Plug Gauge Inspection
clauses.acceptableLimit: Conforms to Table 1 & Table 2 tolerances

clauses.title: Temperature Rise Under 16A Continuous Load
clauses.description: Terminal and contact temperature rise under continuous full-load current.
clauses.testMethod: Thermocouple measurement after 1 hour continuous 16A AC current
clauses.acceptableLimit: Temperature rise <= 45 K

clauses.title: Mechanical Durability & Endurance (10,000 Cycles)
clauses.description: Shutter and contact retention spring endurance under repetitive insertion and withdrawal.
clauses.testMethod: Pneumatic endurance test rig operating at 30 strokes/minute for 10,000 cycles
clauses.acceptableLimit: Zero mechanical jamming; shutter closes completely upon withdrawal

clauses.title: Glow-Wire Flammability Resistance
clauses.description: Resistance of insulating material retaining current-carrying parts to abnormal heat and fire.
clauses.testMethod: Glow-wire test at 850°C
clauses.acceptableLimit: No sustained flame or self-extinction within 30 seconds

standards.title: Switches for Domestic and Similar Purposes
standards.description: Safety and performance requirements for manually operated general purpose switches for AC installations up to 250V and rated current up to 32A.

clauses.title: Making and Breaking Capacity Under Rated Load
clauses.description: Switch ability to safely make and break load circuits with power factor 0.6.
clauses.testMethod: 200 operations at 1.1 times rated voltage and 1.25 times rated current
clauses.acceptableLimit: Zero sustained arcing, welding of contacts, or enclosure rupture

clauses.title: Normal Operation Endurance (40,000 Cycles)
clauses.description: Mechanical and electrical contact endurance under repeated operation.
clauses.testMethod: 40,000 continuous operations at rated current and voltage (30 operations/min)
clauses.acceptableLimit: Temperature rise <= 45 K; no electrical or mechanical failure

clauses.title: Insulation Resistance & Electric Strength
clauses.description: Dielectric insulation across open contacts and between live parts and accessible frame.
clauses.testMethod: 2000V AC rms applied for 1 minute following 48h humidity chamber conditioning
clauses.acceptableLimit: Zero flashover; insulation resistance >= 5.0 MΩ

standards.title: Electrical Accessories - Circuit-Breakers for Overcurrent Protection (MCB)
standards.description: Air-break circuit-breakers for operation at 50 Hz, with rated voltage not exceeding 440 V and rated current not exceeding 125 A.

clauses.title: Tripping Characteristics (Type B / C / D Curves)
clauses.description: Verification of thermal bi-metallic overload and electromagnetic instantaneous trip thresholds.
clauses.testMethod: Calibrated current injection at 1.13 In (non-tripping) and 1.45 In (conventional tripping current)
clauses.acceptableLimit: Tripping time between 0.1s and 5.0s at specified threshold curve

clauses.title: Rated Short-Circuit Capacity (Icn = 10 kA)
clauses.description: Breaking and extinguishing high fault current without fire or external hazard.
clauses.testMethod: 10 kA short circuit test sequence O - t - CO at rated operating voltage
clauses.acceptableLimit: Safe arc chute containment; dielectric strength retained >= 1500V post-fault

clauses.title: Temperature Rise of Terminals Under In Load
clauses.description: Operating terminal temperature under continuous rated current In.
clauses.testMethod: Continuous rated current injection until thermal equilibrium is attained
clauses.acceptableLimit: Terminal temperature rise <= 60 K

standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - General Requirements
standards.description: Governs electrical, mechanical, thermal, fire, and radiation hazards of household electrical appliances under normal and abnormal conditions.

clauses.title: Protection Against Access to Live Parts
clauses.description: Enclosure protection preventing fingers or tools from touching hazardous live electrical components.
clauses.testMethod: Standard jointed test finger (IEC 61032 probe B) applied with 20 N force in all directions
clauses.acceptableLimit: Zero contact with uninsulated live circuits

clauses.title: Leakage Current and Electric Strength at Operating Temperature
clauses.description: Measurement of leakage current to accessible conductive parts during peak thermal state.
clauses.testMethod: Continuous 1.15 times rated power input until steady thermal state; measurement with milli-ammeter
clauses.acceptableLimit: Leakage current <= 0.75 mA for Class I portable appliances

clauses.title: Provision for Earthing (Grounding Continuity)
clauses.description: Low-resistance path between accessible metal parts and ground pin.
clauses.testMethod: 25A current injection from 12V supply between earth terminal and exposed metal for 1 minute
clauses.acceptableLimit: Earthing circuit resistance <= 0.10 Ohm

standards.title: Stationary Storage Type Electric Water Heaters (Geysers)
standards.description: Specifies constructional, electrical, hydrostatic pressure resistance, and standing heat loss energy efficiency for domestic water heaters.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Pressure Test of Tank (1.5x Rated Pressure)
clauses.description: Inner stainless steel or enamel-coated tank pressure containment under high water mains pressure.
clauses.testMethod: Hydraulic pressure held at 1.2 MPa (12 bar) for 15 minutes
clauses.acceptableLimit: Zero water leakage, permanent tank deformation, or rupture

clauses.title: Standing Heat Loss per 24 Hours (BEE 5-Star Benchmark)
clauses.description: Thermal insulation efficiency of polyurethane foam (PUF) insulation around hot water reservoir.
clauses.testMethod: 48 hour energy measurement in thermostatic chamber maintained at 20°C +/- 1°C
clauses.acceptableLimit: Standing loss <= 0.380 kWh / 24h / 45K temperature difference

clauses.title: Thermal Cut-Out & Safety Relief Valve Operation
clauses.description: Independent secondary safety cut-out that trips in case of thermostat stuck-on failure.
clauses.testMethod: Simulated thermostat bypass dry-run heating test
clauses.acceptableLimit: Non-self-resetting cut-out trips cleanly between 90°C and 95°C; safety valve releases at 0.8 MPa

standards.title: Secondary Cells and Batteries containing Alkaline or other non-acid Electrolytes - Lithium Systems
standards.description: Mandatory safety requirements for portable sealed secondary lithium cells and batteries used in smartphones, laptops, power tools, and EV modules.

clauses.title: Continuous Charging at Constant Voltage
clauses.description: Fully charged cells are subjected to continuous charge for 7 days at max rated voltage.
clauses.testMethod: Constant 4.25V per cell charge at 20°C for 168 hours
clauses.acceptableLimit: No fire, no explosion, no electrolyte leakage

clauses.title: External Short Circuit at Elevated Temperature (55°C)
clauses.description: Fully charged battery pack short-circuited with external resistance < 80 mΩ at elevated ambient temperature.
clauses.testMethod: Direct copper shunt application in thermal chamber at 55°C
clauses.acceptableLimit: Case temp <= 150°C; zero fire or explosive disassembly

clauses.title: Free Fall Drop Impact Test
clauses.description: Enclosure impact integrity when dropped onto flat concrete floor from 1.0m height.
clauses.testMethod: 1.0m drop test on each face onto concrete floor (total 3 drops)
clauses.acceptableLimit: No fire, no explosion, enclosure intact, no internal short circuit

clauses.title: Thermal Abuse & Oven Resistance (130°C)
clauses.description: Resistance of cell separator to thermal shrinkage and catastrophic thermal runaway in elevated temperature oven.
clauses.testMethod: Thermal chamber ramped at 5°C/min to 130°C +/- 2°C, held for 10 minutes
clauses.acceptableLimit: Zero ignition, persistent fire, or explosive disassembly

clauses.title: Mechanical Crush Test
clauses.description: Mechanical deformation resistance under heavy hydraulic bar press simulating road crash or vehicle crush.
clauses.testMethod: Hydraulic piston crush up to 13.0 kN force between flat jaws
clauses.acceptableLimit: No explosion, thermal runaway ignition, or persistent flame

standards.title: Information Technology Equipment - Safety - General Requirements
standards.description: Comprehensive safety standard for laptops, desktop computers, mobile phones, power adapters, printers, scanners, and servers.

clauses.title: Protection Against Electric Shock from Accessible Enclosures
clauses.description: No accessible metal or plastic parts may become energized at SELV / hazardous primary voltage.
clauses.testMethod: Standard test probe with 30 N force; touch voltage measurement across secondary circuit
clauses.acceptableLimit: Accessible secondary voltage <= 42.4 V peak (or 60 V DC)

clauses.title: Insulation Resistance & Electric Strength (Hi-Pot Test)
clauses.description: High potential dielectric isolation between primary live input and output DC connector.
clauses.testMethod: 3000 V AC rms applied between primary AC prongs and secondary USB/DC port for 60 seconds
clauses.acceptableLimit: Insulation resistance >= 7.0 MΩ; zero insulation breakdown or flashover

clauses.title: Thermal Heating Under Full Processing Load
clauses.description: Maximum surface temperatures of power supply brick and external enclosure touchpoints.
clauses.testMethod: Full rated load burn-in for 4 hours at 25°C ambient temperature
clauses.acceptableLimit: External touchable plastic enclosure <= 75°C; internal transformer winding <= 110°C

clauses.title: Abnormal Operating and Fault Conditions
clauses.description: Simulated short-circuit of bridge rectifier, output electrolytic capacitors, and optocoupler.
clauses.testMethod: Direct shorting of key discrete components one at a time for 2 hours
clauses.acceptableLimit: Internal fuse trips safely; zero flame, molten metal projection, or toxic smoke

standards.title: Safety of Lamp Controlgear - Electronic Controlgear for LED Modules
standards.description: Safety guidelines for D.C. or A.C. supplied electronic controlgear (LED drivers, constant voltage/current power supplies) used in luminaires.

clauses.title: Protection Against Electric Shock
clauses.description: Accessible parts of the LED driver must have adequate insulation from primary live circuits.
clauses.testMethod: Standard test finger inspection at 20 N force
clauses.acceptableLimit: No electrical contact with SELV/hazardous live parts

clauses.title: Moisture Resistance & Insulation Resistance
clauses.description: Withstand 48 hours in humidity chamber (91-95% RH) followed by 500V DC megger test.
clauses.testMethod: Humidity chamber at 25°C followed by 500V DC insulation test
clauses.acceptableLimit: Insulation resistance >= 4.0 MΩ

clauses.title: Fault Condition Testing (Output Short Circuit)
clauses.description: Driver must safely handle output short circuits and transformer primary failures without fire or smoke.
clauses.testMethod: Output terminal direct short-circuit for 4 hours continuous
clauses.acceptableLimit: No emission of flames, molten material, or toxic gas

standards.title: Safety of Power Converters for use in Photovoltaic Power Systems - Particular Requirements for Inverters
standards.description: Grid-tied and off-grid solar rooftop and utility PV inverters safety, anti-islanding, DC injection, and insulation protection.

clauses.title: Anti-Islanding Protection Disconnect Time
clauses.description: Automatic instantaneous disconnection of solar inverter upon loss of main utility grid supply.
clauses.testMethod: AC breaker trip simulation with resonant R-L-C load matched to inverter output
clauses.acceptableLimit: Disconnection within <= 2.0 seconds; zero voltage backfeed to utility lines

clauses.title: DC Current Injection into AC Grid
clauses.description: Restriction on harmful direct current flowing from solar PV array into distribution grid.
clauses.testMethod: Precision DC shunt hall-effect measurement at 100% inverter rated output power
clauses.acceptableLimit: DC current injection <= 0.5% of rated output current

clauses.title: Ingress Protection & Thermal Runaway in Outdoor Enclosure
clauses.description: IP65 weatherproof enclosure testing against dust penetration and high-pressure water jets.
clauses.testMethod: Talcum dust chamber (8 hours) followed by 12.5 mm water jet at 100 kPa for 3 minutes
clauses.acceptableLimit: Conforms to IP65; zero water or conductive dust ingress

standards.title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement (TMT Rebars)
standards.description: Mandatory mechanical, chemical, and bend characteristics of thermo-mechanically treated (TMT) steel rebars (Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550D) for infrastructure.

clauses.title: Yield Stress / 0.2% Proof Stress (Fe 500D Grade)
clauses.description: Minimum 0.2% proof stress / yield strength for ductile earthquake-resistant construction.
clauses.testMethod: Universal Testing Machine (UTM) tensile test according to IS 1608
clauses.acceptableLimit: Minimum 500.0 N/mm² (MPa)

clauses.title: Tensile Strength to Yield Ratio (TS / YS Ratio)
clauses.description: Ratio of ultimate tensile strength to yield stress ensuring structural seismic plastic reserve.
clauses.testMethod: Calculated from ultimate tensile load and proof stress measurement
clauses.acceptableLimit: TS / YS ratio >= 1.10; Ultimate Tensile Strength >= 565.0 N/mm²

clauses.title: Percentage Elongation at Gauge Length 5.65√So
clauses.description: Ductility under tension to prevent brittle fracture during earthquakes or severe load shifts.
clauses.testMethod: Extensometer gauge measurement after fracture under UTM
clauses.acceptableLimit: Elongation >= 16.0%

clauses.title: Chemical Composition - Carbon & Sulphur/Phosphorus Limits
clauses.description: Chemical purity and weldability restriction on harmful embrittling elements.
clauses.testMethod: Optical Emission Spectrometry (OES) analysis of ladle sample
clauses.acceptableLimit: Carbon <= 0.25%; Sulphur <= 0.040%; Phosphorus <= 0.040%; S+P <= 0.075%

standards.title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification (33, 43 and 53 Grade)
standards.description: Statutory physical and chemical requirements for Ordinary Portland Cement used in structural concrete, pre-stressed members, and heavy construction.

clauses.title: 28-Day Compressive Strength (53 Grade OPC)
clauses.description: Compressive strength of mortar cubes made from standard Ennore sand after 28 days curing.
clauses.testMethod: Compressive testing machine load on 70.6 mm mortar cubes (IS 4031 Part 6)
clauses.acceptableLimit: Minimum 53.0 MPa (N/mm²)

clauses.title: Initial & Final Setting Time
clauses.description: Workability window for pouring concrete and rate of hydration hardening.
clauses.testMethod: Vicat needle apparatus test at standard consistency paste (IS 4031 Part 5)
clauses.acceptableLimit: Initial setting time >= 30 minutes; Final setting time <= 600 minutes

clauses.title: Soundness by Le-Chatelier Method
clauses.description: Expansion resistance of unhydrated free lime and magnesia preventing concrete cracking.
clauses.testMethod: Boiling Le-Chatelier split cylinder gauge in water bath for 3 hours (IS 4031 Part 3)
clauses.acceptableLimit: Expansion <= 10.0 mm

clauses.title: Chemical Limits - Insoluble Residue & Magnesia (MgO)
clauses.description: Purity of clinker minerals and control of unreacted silica/alumina contaminants.
clauses.testMethod: Wet chemical gravimetric analysis (IS 4032)
clauses.acceptableLimit: Insoluble residue <= 5.0%; Magnesia (MgO) <= 6.0%; Loss on Ignition <= 5.0%

standards.title: High Density Polyethylene Pipes for Water Supply - Specification
standards.description: Virgin polymer HDPE pipes for municipal potable water supply, high-pressure distribution, and sewer main conduits.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Internal Pressure Resistance (100h at 20°C)
clauses.description: Pipe bursting resistance under continuous hydraulic hoop stress for PE 100 grade resin.
clauses.testMethod: End-capped water bath pressurization at 12.4 MPa induced circumferential stress
clauses.acceptableLimit: Zero weeping, pinhole leakage, bursting, or swelling after 100 hours

clauses.title: Oxidation Induction Time (OIT at 200°C)
clauses.description: Thermal antioxidant stabilizer content guaranteeing 50-year service life.
clauses.testMethod: Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC) oxygen purge test at 200°C
clauses.acceptableLimit: OIT >= 20 minutes

clauses.title: Carbon Black Content & Dispersion Grade
clauses.description: Ultraviolet (UV) degradation resistance through micro-dispersed carbon black.
clauses.testMethod: Thermogravimetric nitrogen furnace pyrolysis and optical microscopy (IS 2530)
clauses.acceptableLimit: Carbon black content 2.0% to 2.5%; Dispersion grading <= Grade 3

standards.title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water)
standards.description: Statutory chemical, microbiological, radiological, and physical requirements for commercial bottled drinking water.

clauses.title: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) & pH Value
clauses.description: General chemical potability parameters and mineral balance.
clauses.testMethod: Gravimetric dried residue test at 180°C and calibrated glass electrode pH meter
clauses.acceptableLimit: TDS: 75 to 500 mg/L (ppm); pH: 6.5 to 8.5

clauses.title: Toxic Heavy Metals - Lead (Pb) and Arsenic (As)
clauses.description: Maximum allowable thresholds for toxic heavy metals harmful to human health.
clauses.testMethod: Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry (ICP-MS) or Atomic Absorption (AAS)
clauses.acceptableLimit: Lead (Pb) <= 0.01 mg/L; Arsenic (As) <= 0.01 mg/L; Cadmium <= 0.003 mg/L

clauses.title: Microbiological Safety - Coliform & E. coli Count
clauses.description: Zero tolerance for waterborne biological and faecal pathogens.
clauses.testMethod: Membrane filtration method using M-Endo agar incubated at 37°C for 24h
clauses.acceptableLimit: Zero (Absent) in 250 ml of sample; Faecal Streptococci: Absent in 250 ml

clauses.title: Pesticide Residue Limits (Individual & Total)
clauses.description: Trace pesticide residue limits following multi-barrier RO/UV filtration.
clauses.testMethod: Gas Chromatography Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS/MS) multi-residue pesticide screen
clauses.acceptableLimit: Individual pesticide <= 0.0001 mg/L (0.1 ppb); Total pesticides <= 0.0005 mg/L

standards.title: Protective Helmets for Two Wheeler Riders - Specification
standards.description: Mandatory safety parameters for protective helmets ensuring skull impact absorption, chin strap retention, and optical visor clarity.

clauses.title: Impact Absorption & Shock Deceleration Test
clauses.description: Headform peak deceleration attenuation when dropped onto flat steel and hemispherical anvils.
clauses.testMethod: Drop tower release from 2.85 m height (impact velocity 7.5 m/s) with triaxial accelerometer headform
clauses.acceptableLimit: Peak headform deceleration <= 275 g (gravity); Deceleration > 150 g duration <= 5.0 ms

clauses.title: Retention System (Chin Strap) Dynamic Extension & Slippage
clauses.description: Chin strap buckle security preventing helmet detachment during road ejection.
clauses.testMethod: Initial pre-load of 50 N followed by instantaneous 1.0 kN dynamic drop shock load
clauses.acceptableLimit: Dynamic extension <= 35 mm; Residual slippage <= 25 mm; Buckle remains locked

clauses.title: Visor Optical Transmission & Mechanical Penetration
clauses.description: Polycarbonate visor visual transparency and flying gravel shatter resistance.
clauses.testMethod: Light spectrophotometer transmission test and 6 mm steel ball shot at 60 m/s
clauses.acceptableLimit: Luminous transmittance >= 85%; Zero shatter, piercing, or sharp shard formation

standards.title: Safety of Toys - Mechanical and Physical Properties
standards.description: Quality Control Order (QCO) safety standards for infant and children's toys preventing choking, sharp edges, and pinch hazards.

clauses.title: Small Parts Ingestion & Choking Hazard Cylinder
clauses.description: Parts intended for children under 36 months must not fit inside truncated child throat test cylinder.
clauses.testMethod: Standard truncated test cylinder inspection (31.7 mm diameter x 57.1 mm depth)
clauses.acceptableLimit: No detachable component or broken fragment fits entirely within cylinder

clauses.title: Sharp Points and Cutting Edges
clauses.description: Enclosures, stampings, and metallic edges must be deburred or hemmed to prevent skin laceration.
clauses.testMethod: Calibrated sharp edge tester mandrel with PTFE tape and sharp point gauge (1.0 mm travel)
clauses.acceptableLimit: Zero accessible sharp edges or puncturing points

clauses.title: Abuse Drop Impact & Torque/Tension Endurance
clauses.description: Withstand dropping 5 times from 850 mm height onto steel plate and 60 N pull tension on limbs.
clauses.testMethod: 5 successive drop tests followed by 60 N tensile pull on joints/eyes for 10 seconds
clauses.acceptableLimit: No accessible hazard created; seams, eyes, and batteries remain locked

standards.title: Personal Protective Equipment - Safety Footwear (Industrial Steel Toe Boots)
standards.description: Mandatory footwear safety specification specifying 200 Joules toe cap impact resistance, sole puncture resistance, and anti-slip grip.

clauses.title: Toe Cap Impact Resistance (200 Joules Kinetic Energy)
clauses.description: Steel/composite safety toe cap protection when subjected to heavy falling objects.
clauses.testMethod: 20 kg striker dropped from 1.02 m height imparting exactly 200 Joules impact energy
clauses.acceptableLimit: Clearance beneath toe cap >= 14.0 mm for size 8 boot; zero toe cap cracking

clauses.title: Sole Penetration Resistance (1100 N Nail Puncture)
clauses.description: Resistance of midsole to penetration by sharp nails, scrap metal, or building debris.
clauses.testMethod: Steel test nail (4.5 mm diameter) pressed into sole unit at 10 mm/min until penetration occurs
clauses.acceptableLimit: Penetration force >= 1100 N before tip pierces internal insole

clauses.title: Upper Leather Tear Strength & Water Resistance
clauses.description: Durability of full-grain buffalo/cow leather upper under abrasive industrial exposure.
clauses.testMethod: Tensile clamp tear test at 100 mm/min (IS 15298-1)
clauses.acceptableLimit: Tear strength >= 120 N; Water penetration time >= 60 minutes

standards.title: Domestic Pressure Cookers - Safety and Performance
standards.description: Quality Control Order mandatory standard specifying aluminium and stainless steel cooker burst resistance, fusible plug safety, and vent pipe clearance.

clauses.title: Proof Pressure & Hydrostatic Burst Test
clauses.description: Pressure containment of cooker body and lid locking mechanism without explosive rupture.
clauses.testMethod: Hydraulic pressurization with weight valve locked to twice working operating pressure
clauses.acceptableLimit: Withstand 200 kPa (2.0 bar) proof pressure for 5 min; Burst pressure >= 300 kPa

clauses.title: Fusible Safety Relief Plug Release Temperature
clauses.description: Secondary safety valve operating when main vent weight pipe is completely blocked.
clauses.testMethod: Dry heat cooker test on flame with vent weight obstructed
clauses.acceptableLimit: Fusible alloy melts and releases steam safely between 110°C and 130°C

clauses.title: Gasket Release System (GRS) Pressure Relief
clauses.description: Controlled lid gasket deflection to vent excess pressure before vessel structural rupture.
clauses.testMethod: Vent and safety valve blocked with progressive hydraulic pressure ramp
clauses.acceptableLimit: Gasket vents pressure safely between 180 kPa and 240 kPa

standards.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Safety Requirements - Rechargeable Electrical Energy Storage System (REESS)
standards.description: Mandatory AIS/BIS automotive safety requirements for traction battery packs against thermal runaway propagation, fire, and immersion.

clauses.title: Single Cell Thermal Runaway Initiation & Propagation
clauses.description: Triggering a thermal runaway in a single cell must not propagate to adjacent cells in the pack for at least 10 minutes.
clauses.testMethod: Ceramic cartridge heater trigger at 100°C/min inside sealed battery pack
clauses.acceptableLimit: No fire, explosion, or smoke venting into passenger cabin for min 10 minutes

clauses.title: Saltwater Immersion & High Pressure Water Jet Test
clauses.description: Water ingress resistance when vehicle is flooded in monsoon waters.
clauses.testMethod: Submersion in 3.5% NaCl solution for 2 hours followed by post-monitoring
clauses.acceptableLimit: No fire, explosion; insulation resistance >= 100 Ohm/Volt

standards.title: IS 9 — Official Indian Standard Specification (Electrical Equipment & Appliances)
standards.description: Official statutory quality, mechanical safety, electrical, and chemical performance specification established by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS).

clauses.title: Raw Material Composition & Purity Verification
clauses.description: Material grades, chemical purity, and metallurgical or polymer formulation limits.
clauses.testMethod: Chemical spectrochemical analysis or FTIR polymer verification
clauses.acceptableLimit: Conforms to Table 1 chemical composition tolerances

clauses.title: Mechanical Strength & Physical Performance Criteria
clauses.description: Withstand statutory operating stress, proof load, or dimensional tolerances.
clauses.testMethod: Universal tensile/compression or calibrated gauge inspection
clauses.acceptableLimit: Must meet or exceed minimum specified mechanical yield/pressure threshold

clauses.title: Thermal, Environmental & Endurance Testing
clauses.description: Resistance to abnormal operating heat, environmental humidity, ingress, or flammability.
clauses.testMethod: Conditioning in environmental test chamber followed by dielectric/functional verification
clauses.acceptableLimit: Zero flashover, structural rupture, or dangerous thermal runaway

clauses.title: Marking, Traceability & Standard Mark (ISI / CRS)
clauses.description: Permanent indelible marking of manufacturer name, batch/lot number, and official BIS license number.
clauses.testMethod: Rubbing test with water and petroleum spirit for 15 seconds
clauses.acceptableLimit: Marking remains legible; contains genuine CM/L or R-number
